name: reactive-resume
description_en: A one-of-a-kind resume builder that keeps your privacy in mind. Completely secure, customizable, portable, open-source and free forever. Try it out today!
readme_excerpt: Reactive Resume Reactive Resume is a free and open-source resume builder that makes it easy to create, update, and share your resume. Get Started · Learn More Pick a template, fill in your details, and export to PDF. Basic use needs no account. If you want more control, you can run the whole application on your own infrastructure.
